summary: North Mini Code is Cohere's first North-family agentic coding model: a 30B-total / 3B-active Mixture of Experts model under the Apache 2.0 license. Cohere's docs state it is free on both trial and production API keys until rate limits are reached. The rate-limit table lists 20 requests/min for trial keys and 500 requests/min for production keys. Trial keys (and production keys on newer Chat model variants) are limited to 1,000 API calls a month. The weights can be downloaded from Hugging Face or used through the Cohere API.
claim_steps: Create a Cohere account and get a trial or production API key
Call the North Mini Code model through the Cohere Chat API (free until rate limits are reached)
Or download the Apache 2.0 weights from Hugging Face to run locally
